description: This file declares functions, types, and constants related to WLD endpoints, including profile management, connection status, security compliance, and WPS operations, for a wireless device or network component.

methods.name: syncData_EndPoint2OBJ
methods.description: Synchronizes endpoint data to an object.

methods.name: syncData_OBJ2EndPoint
methods.description: Synchronizes object data to an endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_fromObj
methods.description: Creates an endpoint from an object.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_setProfile_ocf
methods.description: Sets the profile of an endpoint with OCF parameters.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_setCurrentProfile
methods.description: Sets the current profile for an endpoint.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_setProfileSecurity_ocf
methods.description: Sets security profile parameters for an endpoint.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_isEnabledWithRef
methods.description: Checks if endpoint is enabled with reference.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_hasStackEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint has stack enabled.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_setConnectionStatus
methods.description: Sets the connection status of an endpoint.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_connStatusFromEpError
methods.description: Gets connection status from endpoint error.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_sendPairingNotification
methods.description: Sends pairing notification for an endpoint.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_isProfileMloCompliant
methods.description: Checks if two profiles are MLO compliant.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_isSecurityModeMloCompliant
methods.description: Checks if security mode is MLO compliant.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_create_reconnect_timer
methods.description: Creates a reconnect timer for an endpoint.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_performConnectCommit
methods.description: Performs connection commit for an endpoint.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_fromIt
methods.description: Creates an endpoint from an iterator.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_needCreateIface
methods.description: Checks if interface creation is needed.

methods.name: wld_endpoint_needDestroyIface
methods.description: Checks if interface destruction is needed.
